description: Back on the deck, with the chefs kept apart. Each half of the kitchen has some of what a soup needs and none of the rest, so ingredients, plates and dishes all cross the divider counter.
strategy: Keep the plates where both chefs can reach them, on the divider. Pots come off their burners and a held plate takes soup straight from a cooked pot, so the food can cross as a pot, a plate or a finished dish.
